verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents physics through integrated engines (Havok, Cannon.js, Ammo.js, Oimo.js) and offers scene interaction through ray casting and mesh picking, so the core of the story is covered. However, physics is delivered by plugging in an external engine rather than a single built-in system, and the pack never details rigid bodies or collision handling. One community comment harshly criticizes the physics implementation, but it is opinion without a concrete reproducible failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of rigid-body and collision APIs, evidence that physics works out of the box without choosing and adding an engine plugin, and hands-on corroboration that physics works well.
